content.value: 40 cmm of a mixture of outdoor air and recirculated air enters a cooling coil at 34°C DBT and 60% RH. The effective surface temperature of the coil is 6°C. The coil surface area is such that it would give 15 kW cooling effect with the given entering state. Determine the dry bulb and wet bulb temperature of the air leaving the coil and the bypass factor of the coil.
